title: 社会・集団・家族心理学
subtitle: Social, Group and Family Psychology
teachers:
KATO Juri
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will learn about:
(1) social impacts on self and social cognition.
(2) dynamics of families, groups, and culture.
(3) methodology of studying social psychology.
advice:
We will cover the following topics:

1. Methodology of studying social psychology
2. Interpersonal cognition
3. Social cognition and social inference
4. Attitudes and persuasion
5. Conformity, social loafing, and social dilemma
6. Family relationships
7. Social psychology in different regions and cultures

This subject is subject to the course credit system.
requiredKnowledge: Completion of the “Elements of Psychology” and “Method of Psychological Research” courses is recommended.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand and explain the process of social cognition.
Ability to understand and explain the process of changing attitudes.
Ability to understand and explain the relationships between members in a family or group.

achievementLevels.ideal: Explain interpersonal relationships, the meaning and role of attitudes, and the relationships between members of a family or group. In addition, consider how to apply this knowledge in human relationships.
achievementLevels.standard: Understand interpersonal relationships, the meaning and role of attitudes, and the relationships between members of a family or group.
